speaker: charlie
text: Onto science now, and our reef scientists just will not stop tinkering. The coral IVF crews have had another promising spawn of lab grown coral babies ready to be seeded back onto damaged patches of the Great Barrier Reef.

speaker: alice
text: Coral IVF still sounds like something out of a sci-fi movie to me, but it is very real and very clever. Basically they collect coral spawn, grow it up safe and sound, then give the reef a helping hand exactly where it needs it most.

speaker: charlie
text: It is slow, patient work but it is paying off in patches of reef that are genuinely bouncing back. Good on them, because someone has got to look after the world's biggest living structure.
